query:
SELECT 
  u.id,
  u.name,
  u.email,
  u.token_balance,
  u.max_actions,
  u.is_blocked,
  u.created_at,
  COUNT(ua.id) as total_actions,
  MAX(ua.created_at) as last_action
FROM app_users u
LEFT JOIN user_actions ua ON ua.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
